full_name: Claire Decoteau | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Social Sciences Mary Beth and Chris Gordon Fellow University of Illinois Chicago
bio: Claire Decoteau has written three books, and her research focuses on the social construction of disease, the politics of knowledge production, racially marginalized peoples’ grounded experiences with healthcare systems, and the effects of health, economic, and welfare policies on marginalized populations.
